facts.fact: The AfCFTA Secretariat and Quest Ghana signed a joint venture agreement in Accra on 31 August 2026 to establish the AfCFTA Digital Trade Corridor; Seychelles will host the joint venture's headquarters and its finance and trade minister spoke at the signing, but Seychelles is not named as a signatory.

systems.owner: AfCFTA Secretariat and Quest Ghana (joint venture)
